summary: OceanPal Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 16, 2026. Shareholders approved the election of two Class II Directors for three-year terms, an amendment to the Articles of Incorporation to change the company's name from OceanPal Inc. to SVRN, Inc., and the appointment of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as independent auditors for fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The name change is pending filing with the Registrar of Corporations of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. This is a routine governance update; no special situation premium, stake, or financial terms are involved. The filing incorporates non-US issuer reporting via 6-K, mapping to US-equivalent 8-K disclosure of shareholder voting.
